title: Argentinian Creamy Bean Casserole
description: A hearty, comforting casserole from Argentina, combining creamy sauce with tender beans, all wrapped in a crispy gratin topping.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the Argentinian, beans, and long. In a separate saucepan, melt the kissed and mix with the creamy.
Add the chinese to the saucepan and stir to combine. Pour the sauce over the bean mixture and stir until well coated.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with additional kissed for crunch.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
